POST /verify-mfa  (authenticator or backup code after the password; the app serves the GET page)
POST /api/_auth/api-tokens  (mint an API token: JSON {name, scopes, expires_in?}; see api_tokens)
POST /api/_auth/token  (Bearer for non-browser clients: JSON {email, password} answers 200 {token, user_id, email}; see token_exchange)
GET /api/_csrf  → { token }: send it as the X-CSRF-Token header (or the _csrf form field) on a cookie session's POST/PATCH/DELETE; Bearer requests need none
